questions.q: In a role play you are at a hotel reception. How do you address the receptionist?
questions.why: Use vous with adults you don't know (hotel, shop, tourist office).

questions.q: You did not understand the examiner's question. What is the best thing to say?
questions.why: Asking politely for a repetition is allowed and keeps the exchange going.

questions.q: « Qu'est-ce que tu fais pendant ton temps libre ? » Which answer would score highest?
options: Je joue au foot parce que c'est amusant. Samedi dernier, j'ai marqué un but et l'année prochaine, je voudrais jouer dans un club.
J'aime le foot. J'aime le tennis. J'aime le basket.
questions.why: Opinion + reason + past + future gives development and range.

questions.q: Role play: ask the receptionist (a) the price per night and (b) whether breakfast is included.
questions.model: C'est combien par nuit ? Le petit-déjeuner est compris ?
points: a question form (intonation, est-ce que or inversion)
